headline.text: L3 ML4 metal dust from drive shaft visible on product strips — source identified, *first shift* deferred to Monday for repair.

summary: One active metal-contamination risk at L3 ML4: drive shaft shedding metal dust onto product post-demold. L3 also has two cleaning failures — gondola assembled despite failing visual/ATP, vibration 4 and preheat 2 left pending after crew departure. L1 S2 metal detector malfunctioned briefly on second shift, self-resolved within minutes.

food_safety.title: Metal dust from ML4 drive shaft visible on product
food_safety.summary: Drive shaft shedding metal dust; visible on strips after demolding at 05:08 — maintenance deferred repair to first shift Monday due to complexity.
food_safety.status: Open — source identified as drive shaft, maintenance awaiting first shift Monday for repair; no indication product was isolated.

food_safety.title: S2 metal detector malfunction
food_safety.summary: Metal detector intermittently opening (false rejects) on second shift at 15:20 — self-resolved by 15:24 with no maintenance intervention.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — functioning correctly by 15:24, no further issues reported.

sanitation.title: ML4 vibration 4 and preheat 2 cleaning verification incomplete
sanitation.summary: Vibration 4 and preheat 2 failed visual inspection during post-op; cleaning team offsite, area left pending at 23:15.
sanitation.status: Pending — preheat 2 subsequently passed at 05:40; vibration 4 status unconfirmed.

sanitation.title: ML4 gondola failed visual and ATP, assembled anyway
sanitation.summary: Gondola section failed visual (excess chocolate, belts not clean) and ATP not performed — supervisor directed assembly for Monday testing despite cleaning failure.
sanitation.status: Open — gondola belts require reassembly Monday morning per maintenance; cleaning verification incomplete.

opportunities.text: Consider logging S2 metal-detector self-clears in maintenance system — today's 4-minute event resolved without root cause investigation.
Consider adding drive-shaft inspection to ML4 pre-start checklist — today's metal-dust event marks the second maintenance deferral noted in this shift's communications.
Review ML4 post-op cleaning hand-off protocol — gondola assembled for production despite failing visual and ATP, creating Monday startup risk.
